documents.title: Documents
documents.newVersionNote: The file is added as the next version. Earlier versions stay available and the document returns to review.
documents.fileHint: PDF, XLSX, CSV, PNG or JPG, up to {{max}} MB. The server checks the file again and scans it.

tasks.title: Tasks

tasks.assigneeHint: Use Reassign on the task page to change the assignee. A reason is required.
tasks.noOthers: There are no other tasks to depend on.

ledger.label: Active ledger
ledger.none: No ledgers are available to you.
ledger.loadFailed: The ledgers could not be loaded.

accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Import the starter chart or add an account.
accounts.importTitle: Import the starter chart of accounts
accounts.importNote: This is an editable starting point in the usual Egyptian layout. It is NOT a legal or professional certification and must be reviewed by a qualified accountant before real use. Codes that already exist are left unchanged.
accounts.importedNone: Nothing to import: every starter account already exists.
accounts.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate account {{code}}? It will no longer accept new entries.
accounts.hasPostingsHint: The category cannot change because posted entries use this account.
accounts.postableHint: A group account only organises the tree; entries post to postable accounts.

periods.title: Fiscal years and periods
periods.startHint: The year starts on the first day of any month and has twelve monthly periods.
periods.reopenWarning: Reopening lets entries be posted into this period again. The reason is recorded in the audit trail.

journals.title: Journal entries
journals.notFound: This entry was not found in the active ledger.
journals.notEditable: Only draft entries can be edited. Posted entries are changed by reversal.
journals.incompleteLines: Complete or remove line(s): {{lines}}. Each line needs an account and exactly one of debit or credit.
journals.accountsFailed: The accounts could not be loaded.
journals.openingHint: An opening balance entry records the balances carried into this ledger. It follows the same approval and posting rules.
journals.fourEyesNote: You created this entry, so another person must approve it.

reverse.title: Reverse entry
reverse.message: Reversing {{reference}} posts a new entry with debits and credits swapped and links both entries. The original stays in the books.
reverse.dateHint: Leave empty to use today's date. It must fall in an open period.

recurring.title: Recurring entry templates
recurring.hint: Choose a posting date to create a draft from a template. Nothing runs automatically.
recurring.name: Template

reports.postedOnlyNote: Draft, pending and approved entries are excluded.
reports.draftIncludedNote: This is a preview that includes unposted entries. It is not the books.
reports.reconciled: Reconciled: total debits equal total credits.
reports.notReconciled: NOT reconciled: out of balance by {{amount}}

mappings.intro: Choose which ledger accounts invoices, bills and payments post to. A document cannot be issued or approved while a mapping it needs is missing.
mappings.bank: Bank and cash accounts for payments
mappings.bankHint: Receipts and payments can only use the accounts ticked here.
mappings.allowDraftRates: Allow documents to use tax rates that are not professionally verified
mappings.allowDraftRatesHint: When off, a document using a draft tax rate is refused. A warning is shown on every document that uses one.
mappings.readOnly: You can view the mappings but not change them.

hints.arControl: Debited when an invoice is issued, credited by receipts and credit notes.
hints.apControl: Credited when a bill is approved, debited by payments and supplier credits.
hints.vatOutput: Credited with the tax on issued invoices.
hints.vatInput: Debited with the tax on approved bills.
hints.deferredRevenue: Holds revenue billed in advance until it is recognized.
hints.customerCredit: Holds receipts that are not yet allocated to an invoice.
hints.supplierPrepayment: Holds payments that are not yet allocated to a bill.
hints.receivableFromClient: Debited when the firm pays an expense on behalf of a client.
hints.employeePayable: Credited when an expense claim is approved.

recognition.intro: Posts one journal per monthly installment that falls due on or before this date: deferred revenue is debited and revenue credited. If any installment cannot be posted (for example the period is closed), nothing is posted.
recognition.nothing: No installment was due up to that date.
recognition.scheduleNote: Monthly from {{start}} over {{months}} months, recognized at the end of each month.

catalogue.name: Name
catalogue.service-typesIntro: Each service type has a recognition policy and a revenue account in the mappings. The reimbursed-expenses type is what client expenses are re-billed under.
catalogue.expense-categoriesIntro: Each category has an expense account in the mappings and an optional monthly budget.

tax.empty: No tax rates yet. A tax specialist enters and verifies them here.
tax.unverifiedBanner: Rates are unverified demo values — Egyptian tax specialist must verify before use
tax.unverifiedWarning: This document uses a tax rate that is not professionally verified. The amounts are not final until a tax specialist verifies the rate.
tax.notEffective: not in effect on this date
tax.versionNote: Changing the rate, its dates or its status creates a new version. Documents already issued keep the version they used.

parties.name: Name
parties.termsHint: Days until an invoice or bill falls due. The document form suggests it.
parties.noClient: Not a client of the firm
parties.archive: Archive (only possible with no open balance)

docs.notFound: This document does not exist or you cannot see it.
docs.notEditable: Only drafts can be edited. Correct an issued document with a credit note.
docs.approvalNote: This amount reaches the approval threshold: a different user with approval rights must approve it, and approving issues the invoice.
docs.cancelConfirm: Cancel this document? It has no number and no journal.
docs.issuedDone: Issued and posted to the ledger.
docs.approvedDone: Approved and posted to the ledger.
docs.fourEyesNote: You created this item, so a different user must approve it.
docs.limitNote: Approval is limited by role: amounts above your limit need a more senior approver.
docs.deferredNote: A service billed in advance is held as deferred revenue and recognized monthly over the service period.
docs.bearerHint: Client-reimbursable expenses are held as a receivable from the client until they are re-billed.

reminders.loggedOnly: Mock mode: the reminder is only recorded in the history. No email is sent.
reminders.done: Reminder recorded in the history (not sent).
reminders.title: Reminders

credit.intro: Against {{reference}} (open balance {{balance}}). The credit reduces the open balance and posts a reversing journal in proportion to the document's lines.
credit.exceeds: The credit is larger than the open balance ({{balance}}).

payments.noAccounts: No bank or cash accounts are set in the account mappings yet, so payments cannot be recorded.
payments.allocateIntro: Allocate part of the unallocated {{amount}} to open documents.
payments.refundExceeds: The refund is larger than the unallocated amount ({{amount}}).

allocation.title: Allocation
allocation.none: No open documents for this party. The whole amount will be kept as a credit.
allocation.caption: Allocation of the payment across open documents
allocation.overCapacity: The allocations are {{amount}} more than the payment amount.

problem.invalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
problem.overDocument: More than the open balance of this document.

becomes.ar: {{amount}} is not allocated and will be kept as a customer credit.
becomes.ap: {{amount}} is not allocated and will be kept as a supplier prepayment.

recurring.intro: A template makes a normal draft on demand. Nothing is created automatically.
recurring.name: Template

ar.title: Customer statement
ar.unapplied: Part of the closing balance is an unapplied customer credit of {{amount}}.

ap.title: Supplier statement
ap.unapplied: The supplier holds an unapplied prepayment of {{amount}}.

aging.basis: Open balances aged by due date as of {{date}}.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.basis: Revenue from issued invoices: on-issue revenue at issue, deferred revenue as it is recognized, less credit notes. Tax is excluded.

reconciliation.title: Subledger reconciliation
reconciliation.intro: Each subledger is compared with its control account in the general ledger. They must agree.
reconciliation.allOk: Reconciled: every subledger equals its control account.
reconciliation.notOk: NOT reconciled: at least one subledger differs from its control account.
reconciliation.rowDiff: {{name}} {{sub}} differs from control account {{control}} by {{diff}}: NOT reconciled

schedule.title: Payment schedule
schedule.empty: No open bills are due in this period.

budget.title: Budget against actual
budget.note: Read only: actual is the posted spending on each category's mapped expense account in the month.

register.welcome: Set up your accounting office and its owner account.
register.name: Your full name
register.doneVerify: We sent a confirmation link to your email address. Confirm it, then sign in.
register.doneReady: Your office account is ready. Sign in to continue.

fs.notCertified: Starter statement mapping. This is not a legal certification: an accountant must review the mapping and the statements before anyone relies on them.
fs.defaulted: {{count}} accounts follow the starter template because no choice was saved for them.
fs.notFinalized: Not finalized: the range includes unlocked periods
fs.dimensionNote: Filtered by branch or cost centre: this is a slice of the books and does not reconcile with the whole trial balance.

balance_equation.bad: NOT reconciled: assets differ from liabilities + equity by {{amount}}.

cash_reconciliation.ok: Net change in cash equals the cash movement in the ledger: reconciled.
cash_reconciliation.bad: NOT reconciled: the net change in cash differs from the ledger cash movement by {{amount}}.

equity_reconciliation.ok: Closing equity equals assets minus liabilities: reconciled.
equity_reconciliation.bad: NOT reconciled: closing equity differs from assets minus liabilities by {{amount}}.

roles.usersIntro: Assign roles to staff members. Changes apply the next time the person signs in.
roles.selfNote: You cannot change your own roles.
